title: LSR-Ben: A Logical and Scientific Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Process Reward Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.01203v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Currently, process reward models (PRMs) have exhibited remarkable potential for test-time scaling. Since large language models (LLMs) regularly generate flawed intermediate reasoning steps when tackling a broad spectrum of reasoning and decision-making tasks, PRMs are required to possess capabilities for detecting process-level errors in real-world scenarios. translated_title: LSR-Ben：一个用于评估过程奖励模型的逻辑与科学推理基准
translated_abstract: 目前，过程奖励模型（PRM）在测试时扩展方面展现出显著潜力。由于大语言模型（LLM）在处理广泛的推理和决策任务时经常生成有缺陷的中间推理步骤，因此要求PRM具备在真实场景中检测过程级错误的能力。然而，现有基准主要聚焦于数学推理，因而无法全面评估PRM在多样化推理场景中的错误检测能力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了LSR-Ben，这是一个专门设计的过程级基准，用于评估PRM在两大主要推理领域（科学推理和逻辑推理）及九个子领域上的性能。我们在包含PRM和LLM在内的22个多样化模型上进行了广泛实验，并得出两个关键发现：（1）在数学推理之外的领域中，错误……
tldr: 本文提出LSR-Ben基准，涵盖科学推理和逻辑推理两大领域及九个子领域，用于全面评估过程奖励模型在数学推理之外多样化场景中的过程级错误检测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LSR-Ben, a process-level benchmark covering scientific and logical reasoning domains and nine subdomains, designed to comprehensively evaluate the error detection capabilities of process reward models beyond mathematical reasoning.
